cv_text:
SARI DEWI — Application Developer, 3 years.
EXPERIENCE: 2023-2026 building internal tools mainly in PHP (Laravel) and some Python. Wrote a service in Go for a hack week project (a URL shortener) and enjoyed it, but production Go is limited to small scripts. Comfortable with SQL: designed a 12-table MySQL schema and added indexes that reduced a reporting query from 9s to 700ms. Used Docker locally; Kubernetes experience limited to reading deployment manifests.
SKILLS: PHP, MySQL, Python, Go (intermediate), Docker, Git.
report_text:
PROJECT: migration of an internal reporting dashboard.
Problem: the weekly report took 9 seconds and timed out for large tenants.
Approach: added composite indexes, split the query into two steps and cached the aggregate per tenant-night. I considered moving it to a column store but did not have infrastructure support.
Results: p50 went from 9s to 700ms in staging; production numbers were not measured before handover. I documented the schema changes for the next engineer.
